sentences.text: `` Rhythm Nation '' is a song by American singer Janet Jackson , released as the second single from her fourth studio album Janet Jackson 's Rhythm Nation 1814 -LRB- 1989 -RRB- .	Janet Jackson	Janet Jackson	single	single (music)	studio album	studio album
It was written and produced by Jackson , in collaboration with James `` Jimmy Jam '' Harris III and Terrence `` Terry '' Lewis .

Jackson developed the song 's concept in response to various tragedies in the media , deciding to pursue a socially conscious theme by using a political standpoint within upbeat dance music .	socially conscious	socially conscious
In the United States , it peaked at number two on the Billboard Hot 100 and topped the Hot R&B / Hip-Hop Songs and Dance Club Songs singles charts .	Dance Club Songs	Dance Club Songs
It also peak within the top 40 of most singles charts worldwide .

`` Rhythm Nation '' received several accolades , including BMI Pop Awards for `` Most Played Song '' , a Billboard Award for `` Top Dance/Club Play Single '' and Grammy Award nomination for Jackson as `` Producer of the Year . ''	BMI	Broadcast Music, Inc.	Billboard Award	Billboard Awards	Grammy Award	Grammy Award	Producer of the Year	Producer of the Year

It has been included in two of Jackson 's greatest hits collections , Design of a Decade : 1986 -- 1996 -LRB- 1995 -RRB- and Number Ones -LRB- 2009 -RRB- .	Number Ones	Number Ones (Janet Jackson album)
The music video for `` Rhythm Nation '' was directed by Dominic Sena , serving as the final inclusion in Jackson 's long-form Rhythm Nation 1814 film .	Dominic Sena	Dominic Sena
It portrays rapid choreography within a `` post-apocalyptic '' warehouse setting , with Jackson and her dancers adorned in unisex military attire .
It was filmed in black-and-white to portray the song 's theme of racial harmony .	black-and-white	black-and-white	racial harmony	racial unity

Jackson 's record label attempted to persuade her against filming the video , but upon her insistence it became `` the most far-reaching single project the company has ever attempted . ''	single	single (music)	record label	A&M Records

The video received two MTV Video Music Awards for `` Best Choreography '' and `` Best Dance Video . ''	MTV Video Music Awards	MTV Video Music Awards	Best Choreography	Best Choreography	Best Dance Video	Best Dance Video

Jackson also won a Billboard Award for `` Best Female Video Artist '' in addition to the `` Director 's Award '' and `` Music Video Award for Artistic Achievement . ''	Billboard Award	Billboard Awards
The Rhythm Nation 1814 film won a Grammy Award for Best Long Form Music Video .	Grammy Award	Grammy Award	Best Long Form Music Video	Best Long Form Music Video

The video 's outfit was inducted into the National Museum of Women in the Arts and Rock & Roll Hall of Fame , where its hand-written lyrics are also used in the museum 's class on female songwriters .	National Museum of Women in the Arts	National Museum of Women in the Arts	Rock & Roll Hall of Fame	Rock & Roll Hall of Fame

Artists such as Sleigh Bells , Jamie Lidell , and Kylie Minogue have cited the song as an influence , while artists including Lady Gaga , Peter Andre , OK Go , Mickey Avalon , Usher , and Britney Spears have referenced its music video .
